question: Should OpenClaw adopt this stacked command-inventory CLI as a core public/operator contract, including the optional live paired-node observation, before its parent foundation is merged?
rationale: The patch adds a new CLI root and inventory representation rather than repairing an established broken contract; compatibility and ownership cannot be resolved mechanically from the paired-node RPC alone.

options.title: Sponsor the core inventory stack
options.body: Accept the CLI inventory as a core surface, land the foundation in a reviewed order, and then require exact-head live paired-node proof for this slice.

options.title: Keep inventory out of core for now
options.body: Pause this draft stack until maintainers choose a narrower supported operator or plugin boundary for command discovery.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core inventory stack
recommendation.body: Accept the CLI inventory as a core surface, land the foundation in a reviewed order, and then require exact-head live paired-node proof for this slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current-main boundary spans the core CLI and Gateway node diagnostics paths, but the supplied history does not safely identify an individual owner.
